module: Main console test file: it loads lua/console/benchphysics and defines two global test functions, loadOneVehicle (pickup spawn) and benchJSON (loading and merging the pickup's .jbeam files). No automatic call, they must be launched by hand.
notes: benchJSON uses globals (directory, dir) for lack of local.
benchJSON returns nil as soon as a jbeam file cannot be decoded; otherwise returns nothing.

loadOneVehicle.desc: Deletes all objects then spawns vehicles/pickup at the origin.

benchJSON.desc: Lists the .jbeam files (excluding .jbeamc) of vehicles/pickup, reads them, decodes them with json.decode and merges the parts with tableMerge. Logs the number of parts of each file.

returns.desc: nil on a JSON decoding error, otherwise nothing.
